This beta makes application updates less disruptive by separating the download from the decision to install and restart.

## Improvements

- Choosing **Download update** now downloads the new version without asking to close or restart UsageDeck.
- After the download finishes, the same control changes to **Install update**. Installation begins only after you select it and confirm that UsageDeck can restart.
- Update controls in the main window and Settings now show clearer action icons, download progress and busy states.
